turns.content: Hey, I've been going through a lot lately and could really use someone to talk to.
Hi Sarah, I'm here for you. What's been on your mind?
Well, I've made a big decision to cut down on my working hours.
That's a significant step. How are you feeling about it?
It's a mix of relief and uncertainty. I'm glad to have more time for myself, but I worry about my career.
It's completely normal to feel both relieved and anxious. Taking care of your mental health is crucial though.
You're right. I've been trying to focus more on painting, as it helps with my stress.
That's wonderful. Engaging in a hobby can be so therapeutic. Have you noticed any changes in how you feel since you started painting?
Yes, definitely. It's like I can express what's inside without words, but sometimes the pressures of work still get to me.
It sounds like painting has become an important outlet for you. It's okay if work stress still creeps in; what matters is that you have ways to cope.
Thanks, I keep reminding myself of that. It's hard not to feel like I'm falling behind sometimes.
I understand. You've been through a lot with work and relationships. You're doing your best, and that's enough.
I try to remember that. The therapy sessions have helped too. I just worry about Mark being in the hospital; it brings back old anxieties.
It's tough seeing someone you care about struggle. Have you managed to talk to Mark or visit him?
I did visit him. It was really hard, but I think he appreciated the company. I just wish I could do more.
Sometimes being there is enough. You're a good friend, and your support means a lot to him.
Thanks. I just hope he knows that he's not alone.
I'm sure he does. Keep taking care of yourself too; you need your strength to support others.
I will. Cutting back on work is a start, I suppose.
It absolutely is. It's a brave decision, and shows you're prioritizing your well-being.
Sometimes I just doubt if I'm doing the right thing.
Doubt can be part of the process, but remember that prioritizing yourself isn't wrong.
I guess so. It's just that balancing everything feels overwhelming at times.
